mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate hiring costs and inflationary pressure, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in residential construction permits above 1.3 million units per month signals strong household demand for housing, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and higher consumption spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1300.0, SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and declining business investment, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95.0, SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases real discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS >= 0.1, SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) after a contraction signals a recovery in consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS increases > 1.5% MoM, SPX 5d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE signals labor market deterioration, indicating weakening employment momentum and rising joblessness, which reduces household income and consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 0.5% MoM AND UNRATE increases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp MoM, SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term between PAYEMS and UNRATE has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized growth signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized, SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between GDPC1 and 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% per annum signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, which lowers the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
